interface.description: Primary network interface to capture traffic from (e.g., eth0, ens33). Required if interface_alt not set.

interface_alt.description: Alternative primary network interface (alias for 'interface'), for clarity or compatibility.

collector_ip.description: IP address (IPv4 or IPv6) of the NetFlow/IPFIX collector to receive flow records.

collector_port.description: UDP port on the collector (standard: 2055 for IPFIX, 2055/9995 for NetFlow v9).

flow_version.description: Flow record format: 'netflow5', 'netflow9', or 'ipfix'. IPFIX is modern and recommended.

sampling_rate.description: Packet sampling rate (1 = all packets, 10 = every 10th packet). Higher values reduce CPU overhead.

active_timeout.description: Flow active timeout in seconds — when a flow is closed after sustained activity.

idle_timeout.description: Flow idle timeout in seconds — when a flow is closed after no activity.

max_flows_per_packet.description: Maximum flows to bundle per UDP packet (0 = no limit). Use to control packet size and latency.

ipfix_tcp_flags.description: Include TCP flags in IPFIX records (e.g., SYN, FIN, RST). Recommended for analysis.

ipfix_ipv6_ext.description: Include IPv6 extension headers in IPFIX records. Useful for IPv6 troubleshooting.

ipfix_bgp_next_hop.description: Include BGP next-hop info in IPFIX. Only relevant in BGP route reflector setups.

source_ip.description: Source IP address used in flow records (e.g., loopback). Defaults to interface's primary IP.

system_id.description: IPFIX system-id (unique across collectors). 0 = auto-assign using device IP.

observation_domain_id.description: IPFIX observation domain ID — used for multi-domain flows. Set consistently if needed.

log_level.description: Verbosity level for fprobe logs (debug → emerg). Choose 'warning' for production.

log_file.description: Path to write logs (e.g., /var/log/fprobe.log). Omit for syslog only.

pid_file.description: Path to write process PID file for service management.

extra_options.description: Additional key=value or key value pairs (e.g., `buffer-size 65535`). Use sparingly.
